description: Operate Tencent Cloud Data Lake Compute (DLC) via MCP: execute SQL/Spark SQL, browse catalogs/databases/tables/partitions, manage Spark jobs, inspect tasks and logs, diagnose performance, and check engine/user permissions.

display.description_en: Operate Tencent Cloud Data Lake Compute (DLC) via MCP: execute SQL/Spark SQL, browse catalogs/databases/tables/partitions, manage Spark jobs, inspect tasks and logs, diagnose performance, and check engine/user permissions.
display.description_zh: 通过 MCP 操作腾讯云数据湖计算（DLC）：执行 SQL / Spark SQL，浏览 Catalog、数据库、表与分区，管理 Spark 作业，查询任务与日志，诊断任务性能，查看引擎与用户权限。
examples_en: List the databases and tables available in ap-guangzhou
Run SELECT COUNT(*) FROM samuel1.orsers on the testly01 engine
Check why task xxx failed and show me the logs
Show my data and engine permissions in ap-chongqing
Create a Spark job, submit it, and show me the result
examples_zh: 帮我查一下 ap-guangzhou 地域下有哪些数据库和表
在 testly01 引擎上执行 SELECT COUNT(*) FROM samuel1.orders
帮我看看 TaskId xxx 这个任务为什么失败了，查一下日志
查询我在 ap-chongqing 地域的数据权限和引擎权限
创建一个 Spark 作业并提交运行，帮我看看结果
